001: Haoran, do you have any plans for the summer vacation?
I want to travel to Yunnan, and I'm looking at travel guides right now.
Really? I've always wanted to go there too.
That's great, we can plan the itinerary together.
When do you think would be a good time to leave?
I think going in early July would be good, the weather is just right then.
002: Which cities in Yunnan are you planning to visit?
I want to go to Kunming first, then Dali and Lijiang.
That route sounds really nice, I'm looking forward to it too.
Yeah, I heard the scenery along the way is especially beautiful.
About how many days do we need to prepare?
I think we need at least a week to enjoy it fully.
003: About how much money will this trip cost us?
I did the math, about five thousand yuan per person.
Does that budget include accommodation and transportation?
Yes, it all includes, plus the cost of attraction tickets.
That's pretty reasonable, we can book tickets in advance.
Exactly, booking early can save quite a bit of money too.
004: Do you prefer staying in hotels or guesthouses?
I prefer guesthouses, they feel more like they have local character.
I think so too, and they look better in photos.
Then let's mainly look at guesthouses, the prices are more affordable too.
Okay, I'll start searching when I get home tonight.
Thanks for your hard work, remember to share the good ones with me.
005: What special foods are really worth trying in Yunnan?
Crossing-the-bridge rice noodles are a must-try, and also steam pot chicken.
Just hearing about it makes my mouth water, I've noted it down.
Oh, and the wild mushroom hot pot there is also very famous.
Then we definitely need to find a chance to try it.
No problem, I'll take you to the places the locals recommend then.
006: When we get there, should we rent a car or take public transportation?
I think taking the high-speed rail and buses is more convenient.
But some attractions are pretty far from the city, right?
That's okay, we can join a one-day tour group.
That really saves us the trouble, no need to worry about the route ourselves.
Yeah, and the tour guide can also explain the local culture.
007: Do we need to prepare anything special for going to Yunnan?
The UV rays are strong there, so you definitely need to bring sunscreen.
Okay, I've noted that down, anything else?
The temperature difference between morning and evening is big, so you should also prepare a light jacket.
Good thing you reminded me, otherwise I definitely would have forgotten.
We'll remind each other, that way we won't miss anything.
008: Have you checked the weather conditions over there?
Yes, I checked. July is the rainy season, so it might rain.
Will that affect us going out and having fun?
It usually doesn't rain for long, just bring an umbrella.
That's good to hear, I was worried it would rain the whole time.
Don't worry, the scenery is actually even more beautiful after the rain.
009: Should we buy the attraction tickets in advance?
It's best to buy tickets for popular attractions online in advance.
Okay, then let's buy the Jade Dragon Snow Mountain tickets too, right?
Yes, those tickets are very hard to get, we must book them in advance.
Good thing you thought it through so thoroughly, saves us from waiting in line.
When it comes to traveling, you can only enjoy it if you plan ahead.
010: What are you most looking forward to on this trip?
I most want to see the sunrise at Erhai Lake, I heard it's especially beautiful.
I'm really looking forward to it too, we can get up early to go see it.
We'll take some photos then to keep as memories.
Good idea, I can also help you take nice pictures.
Then it's settled, let's have a great time.
